title: Create + dispose
description: 1,000 reactive values, one listener each, then disposed.

title: Write, 1 listener
description: 10,000 writes to one value with one listener.

title: Fan-out
description: 100 writes to one value with 1,000 listeners.

title: Wide derived
description: 1,000 sources summed by one derived value; each source written once, the sum read after every write.

title: Deep chain
description: A chain of 100 derived values; 1,000 writes to the root, the end read after every write.

title: Diamond
description: a -> b, c -> d = b + c with a listener; 1,000 writes. Also counts glitches: the listener seeing a d that does not match a.

title: Batch update
description: 100 sources and a derived sum with a listener; 100 rounds that change every source (batched where the library can), then read the sum.

title: Mount + unmount
description: Mount 1,000 reactive widgets (each subscribing to its own value), one frame, then unmount them, one frame.

title: Rebuild all
description: Write all 1,000 values, then one frame that rebuilds all 1,000 widgets.

title: Rebuild one of 1,000
description: Write one of 1,000 values, then one frame that must rebuild exactly that widget.
